## Change
Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the spec or issue.

## Validation
Describe the checks and eval cases you ran, with their results.

## Scope
List unrelated changes and any release impact.

- [ ] `sh checks/run.sh` passes.
- [ ] Examples and transcripts use fictional data and contain no client details or secrets.
- [ ] A changed skill includes its baseline case and relevant eval evidence.
